svg.title: The fourteen-ETF locked universe organized by asset class
svg.desc: Five-row table layout showing the fourteen ETFs in the locked ticker universe organized by asset class: three US equity ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM) in the top row, two international equity ETFs (EFA, EEM) in the second row, four sector equity ETFs (XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV) in the third row, three fixed income ETFs (TLT, LQD, HYG) in the fourth row, and two commodity ETFs (GLD, DBC) in the fifth row; each ticker box contains the symbol in bold above a brief description of what the ETF tracks.
svg.text: Test 7 — fourteen ETFs across five asset classes (NB01's locked universe)
Sector-equity tickers (in coral) are the same four that Test 6 verifies in NB04's ASSET_CLASS_MAP.
Test 7 verifies they exist in NB01's universe; Test 6 verifies they map correctly in NB04 — defense in depth.
3 + 2 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 14 ETFs. Five asset classes give the portfolio enough breadth for cross-sectional analysis
while staying small enough that each ticker can be visualized individually and audited by hand.
In NB01, the universe lives in a list called TICKERS — and exactly these 14 quoted strings must appear there.
